title: Gaussian Fourier pairing phase
statement: For any real parameter $a$ and vectors $x,y\in\mathbb R^n$, the Gaussian Fourier pairing satisfies $-2\pi\,\mathrm{i}\,\langle x,y\rangle_a=a\sum_{j=1}^n x_jy_j$, where the pairing is the bilinear form defined by the parameter $a$.
caveat: The formal identity has no imaginary unit: it states $-2\pi$ times the pairing equals the real inner-product sum scaled by $a$. The pairing itself is defined by a real bilinear form, so the statement is: $-2\pi\,P_a(x,y)=a\sum_jx_jy_j$.
